{{Top|leg}}
A '''horde''' was a military unit within the [[Kaleesh/Legends|Kaleesh]] military structure known as the [[Kolkpravis]]. A horde consisted of one hundred [[kamen]] and was lead by a [[Tarkhan]]. One hundred to two hundred made up a [[Brigade (Kolkpravis)|brigade]] which was controlled by a [[Baatar]].<ref name="Galaxy at War">''[[Galaxy at War]]''</ref>
